item.title: Investors Bet on a Hair Loss Treatment Boom
item.description: [Bloomberg] Drugmakers are developing a new generation of hair loss treatments, including lotions, pills and longer-lasting injections, targeting a US market where tens of millions of men and women experience pattern hair loss. Joining Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz on Bloomberg This Weekend is Bloomberg News Equities Reporter Avalon Pernell says some treatments could seek approval and reach the market as soon as 2027, drawing investor interest in companies hoping to tap consumers already willing to spend heavily on hair restoration. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Shein’s $100 Billion Valuation Falls to $26 Billion
item.description: [Bloomberg] Shein is heading toward a Hong Kong listing at a valuation of about $26.5 billion, roughly a quarter of its 2022 peak, after earlier efforts to list in New York and London ran into regulatory hurdles. Bloomberg News Consumer Finance Reporter Lisa Du is on Bloomberg This Weekend with hosts Christina Ruffini and Bailey Lipschultz and says the fast-fashion giant is pitching investors on expanding beyond its core brand by acquiring or partnering with other labels, even as geopolitical, regulatory and reputational risks weigh on its growth story. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Venezuela Oil Deal Raises Questions Over US Role
item.description: [Bloomberg] The Trump administration’s deal giving a US-led venture access to 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil could reshape the countries’ economic relationship, but questions remain over its political durability and whether it will provoke a backlash inside Venezuela. Former Deputy National Secuirty Advisor for Middle East Affairs and the Heritage Foundation's Victoria Coates is on Bloomberg This Weekend and argues the agreement could encourage US investment and restore Venezuela’s energy sector, but says economic development must ultimately be accompanied by political liberalization and self-determination. (Source: Bloomberg)
